meta.note: Logo colours sampled from a JPEG, so they're approximate. Everything else is authored.

tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page ground: deep space. Hangar: cool steel-white for manual and press pages.

tokens.name: void-2
tokens.usage: Second ground: the logo poster's field (sampled from the logo, about #0c0e1a). Use it for large backplates behind panels.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Solid face of a window, card or readout.

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Raised strip inside a panel: title bar, selected row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px internal rules, grid lines and dividers. Decorative (below 3:1). Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of a window, button or card, including the cut corners (3.3:1 on `panel` in void; 3.2:1 in hangar).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `void`, `panel` and `panel-2` (14.7:1 on panel in void; 14:1 in hangar).

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: blurbs, hints, labels (6.4:1 on panel; 7.4:1 in hangar).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Micro-text: serials, coordinates, unit codes, timestamps (4.9:1 on panel; 5.3:1 in hangar). The 2Advanced detail layer. Keep it small and quiet.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Electric blue from the logo's lens flare: the active window edge, the line-draw on open, the scan bar, links, the focus ring (9.5:1 on panel).

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a `signal` fill.

tokens.name: armor-white
tokens.usage: Mech armour white (sampled from the logo). Use it in 3D and for large blocks, not for text grounds in void.

tokens.name: armor-navy
tokens.usage: Mech armour navy (logo). Use it for large blocks and 3D. In void it's below 3:1 on the ground, so never use it for text or lines.

tokens.name: armor-red
tokens.usage: Mech armour red (logo): chest and waist blocks, the danger or eject accent. In void it's 3.6:1 on the ground, so use it for marks only. Use `alert` for red text.

tokens.name: armor-gold
tokens.usage: Vent and crest gold (logo): the selected state, the current unit, primary action fills, key letters (9.6:1 on panel).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on an `armor-gold` fill.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Red for text: warnings and the low-fuel readout (6.4:1 on panel).

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Wordmark chrome mid-tone (logo). Use it for decorative metallic type and bevel highlights.

tokens.name: chrome-deep
tokens.usage: Wordmark chrome shadow (logo), the dark end of a chrome ramp.

tokens.name: star-warm
tokens.usage: Warm starlight and the logo's star-streak heads.

tokens.name: star-cool
tokens.usage: Cool starlight. Most stars are this.

tokens.name: nebula-violet
tokens.usage: PROPOSED nebula body. Use it sparingly: one nebula per sector, never a full-screen gradient.

tokens.name: nebula-teal
tokens.usage: PROPOSED second nebula tone.

tokens.name: planet-rust
tokens.usage: PROPOSED Bebop-style dusty-planet rust, for a distant planet or an asteroid's warm side.

tokens.name: thrust
tokens.usage: PROPOSED engine and beam-saber plume core. It blooms out to `signal`.

families.mono: "Share Tech Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: title-word
styles.usage: The title-card word, uppercase and wide like the logo wordmark. Use `text-indent` equal to the tracking.

styles.name: announce
styles.usage: The unit name when you switch. Uppercase, with star streaks.

styles.name: card-name
styles.usage: Unit names on cards and the trigger.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Light frame, long legs. Drifts like it has somewhere better to be.

styles.name: hud
styles.usage: HUD hints. Put the gesture word in weight 700, `ink`.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Telemetry, the stats overlay and boot lines. Tabular.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Serials and coordinates in panel corners, in `ink-faint`. Use one or two per window, never paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a readout pair.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a control's parts.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card grid gap; title-bar padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and window padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between HUD groups; screen inset on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large window padding; cover gutters.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. Stardust has no rounded corners. Shape comes from `cut-*`.

cut.note: The notch language: corner cuts for clip-path. Windows cut two opposite corners (top-left and bottom-right), like armour plates. Small controls cut all four.

tokens.name: cut-xs
tokens.usage: Keycaps and tags.

tokens.name: cut-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, the trigger, readout chips.

tokens.name: cut-md
tokens.usage: Unit cards.

tokens.name: cut-lg
tokens.usage: Windows and dialogs.

duration.note: Window motion is sharp but calm: one clean sequence of about 300ms, with no loops.

tokens.name: dur-line
tokens.usage: Step 1 of open: a 1px `signal` line draws out from the centre.

tokens.name: dur-expand
tokens.usage: Step 2: the window unfolds vertically from that line.

tokens.name: dur-settle
tokens.usage: Step 3: the content fades up 4px and one scan bar sweeps down.

tokens.name: dur-close
tokens.usage: Close: the window collapses to the line, then the line retracts.

tokens.name: ease-snap
tokens.usage: The easing for every window step: fast out, hard stop.

tokens.name: glow-signal
tokens.usage: The active window and focused-card glow. It's the only glow in the UI.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Lifts a window off the starfield. Apply it as a filter drop-shadow on a wrapper, because clip-path cuts a box shadow.
